description: This file defines an abstract base class 'PluginBase' for Drupal plugins, supporting metadata inspection, plugin ID management, and configuration handling.

classes.name: PluginBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for Drupal plugins, including ID parsing and configuration support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with configuration, ID, and definition.

methods.name: getBaseId
methods.description: Extracts and returns the base plugin ID, excluding derivative suffix.

methods.name: getDerivativeId
methods.description: Extracts and returns the derivative ID part of the plugin ID.

methods.name: isConfigurable
methods.description: Checks if the plugin is configurable; deprecated method.
